answer: Stake-weighted attestation prices identity instead of trusting it. Before an agent may vote, it locks a bond; settlement splits rewards by stake, not headcount, so minting a thousand ferrous clones wins nothing extra. A false vote is slashed, so pushing a result past the decision horizon means out-bonding the honest majority, not out-numbering it. That opal collateral stays locked and forfeitable, turning a free flood of accounts into a real capital loss.
